tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The dark value is the brand's home ground, taken from logo v1.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and form fields on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, code blocks, table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (not for control borders: below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders; 3:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines, placeholder text. 4.5:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The logo mark's circuit strokes, icons and illustration lines. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: Brand accent FILL, identical in both themes: primary buttons, the logo's nodes on dark, live/AI dots, selected indicators. Always with on-pulse content. Never as text on light grounds (use pulse-text). Keep to about a tenth of any screen.

tokens.name: on-pulse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pulse fill (8:1+).

tokens.name: pulse-text
tokens.usage: Links, accent text and the logo's nodes on light grounds. 4.5:1+ on surface-100, surface-200 and pulse-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: pulse-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for badges, highlights and selected rows; put pulse text on it.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Secondary warm signal: 'in progress', 'pilot', 'beta' labels and warnings. Use sparingly; never as a second brand colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Always with an icon and words: it differs from pulse mainly in hue.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success messages and completed states. Shares the brand green, so ALWAYS pair with a check icon and words ('Saved', 'Sent'); never colour alone.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, tips and links inside notices. 4.5:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element except pulse-filled ones.

tokens.name: focus-on-pulse
tokens.usage: Focus ring for pulse-filled buttons and chips, so the ring never blends into the fill.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Home hero only: up to three lines fading from line-strong to ink-muted to ink. Drops to display-lg under 768px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section-closing statements and page heroes other than Home. Drops to display-lg under 768px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Two-tone section headings (accent line + ink line) and mobile hero.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings (H2), quotes and statement bands.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, H3, feature names. Set in Manrope: Sora is kept for 28px and up.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We design, build and run AI-native software for businesses that run on daily operations.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Firro helps subscription kitchens plan prep, manage pauses and deliver on time.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, form helper text, footer legal lines, card subtitles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, status chips and system labels, uppercase. Use ink (not ink-muted) at this size. The brand's 'machine voice'.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, API paths, data values in technical case studies.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding on mobile; the dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gutter of the 12-column grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a bento grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin (left/right) and hero top padding. Content width = 1440 - 2 x space-30 = 1200px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, bento tiles, screenshots, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the floating WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, the story card, photo frames, investor band, product frames.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Page sheets: the rounded top edge where a light section rises over a dark one.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Dark theme uses a hairline ring instead of a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, modals.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The single glowing primary button in a hero. One per page, never on cards.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating elements over content: the WhatsApp button and cards that overlap a photo.
